module: Node "Distance From Ground" (category `repeat_instant`, tags gameplay/utils). Measures the distance between the lowest point of the vehicle's oriented bounding box (`getSpawnWorldOOBB`, 8 corners) and the terrain below (`be:getSurfaceHeightBelow`). Input pins: `vehId`, `zOffset` (hidden, default 10: starting height of the ray). Output: `lowestDistance` (number, meters). Option `data.drawDebug` to display the values.
notes: If no ray hits the ground, `lowestDistance` is `math.huge`.
`vehId` is required (no fallback to the player).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Casts a ray downward from each corner of the OOBB and puts the smallest distance to the ground in `lowestDistance`.
